sections.heading: Sharing model
sections.markdown:
- `shared const` is immutable and can be shared across coroutines without copying
- `shared let` represents exclusive mutable ownership and must be transferred with `move`
- ordinary local variables cannot be captured by `go` closures; pass data explicitly
- `go { ... }` is a zero-argument block form; pass local data with `go fn(x: T) -> R { ... }(arg)` or `go worker(arg)`

sections.heading: await all
sections.markdown: `await all` requires a homogeneous collection of tasks: every element must have the same static `Task<T>` type, and the result is `Array<T>`. Await heterogeneous tasks individually, or convert each task to a shared enum / union / Json result type.

sections.heading: Atomic
sections.markdown: `Atomic<T>` wraps `int`/`float`/`bool` with lock-free atomic operations. Must be `shared const`; `move` prohibited. Methods: `load`, `store`, `add`, `sub`, `fetchAdd`, `fetchSub`, `swap`, `compareExchange`, `toggle`. Optional `Ordering` enum parameter (default `SeqCst`).
